title: date_of_death output
description: Ported from v0 date_of_death (demographics -> death-search -> holistic vital-status inference). 'date_of_death' is the explicit confirmed date (never estimated); 'vital_status' may be 'dead' with a null date (confirmed dead, no date). 'date_of_death' is the field downstream recipes read. 'evidence_chunk_id' grounds the determination (the demographics row or note the deciding pass read) -- vital_status is a real clinical claim, so dead/alive cite their source; a null/'unknown' non-determination may carry null.
